description: List bookable meeting rooms in the user's Microsoft 365 organisation (read-only). Reads Graph `places` (all pages, up to 1,000 rooms): name, email address, building, floor, capacity and devices. `places` needs the Place.Read.All permission, which this server doesn't request yet (#337); when Graph refuses it, the tool falls back to the beta `findRooms` call (User.Read; names and addresses only, first 100 rooms), and says so in the result. A room's email address works as a `create-event` attendee with type `resource`. Filter by `query` (name or address), `building`, `floor` or minimum `capacity`; filters run on the returned list, and `findRooms` results can't be filtered by building, floor or capacity. Personal Microsoft accounts (Outlook.com) have no rooms: the call returns an error saying so. `outputVerbosity` controls field count.
name: find-meeting-rooms
title: Meeting Rooms
